function.name: SearchKnowledgeBase
function.description: search knowledge base for the knowledge about technology or algorithms field, get rid of results whose confidence is lower than 0.5 before return to user

filename.description: doc filename to search, if you want to search in all documents, leave it empty.

domain.description: domain to search, if you want to search in all domains, leave it empty.

topK.description: number of top results you want to return, default is 3. Usually, around 10 results are useful.
